source: P3 pilot property record of icheme:pilot_cryogenic (batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature, WP3). PR78 constants, molar mass, normal boiling point and standard density identical to icheme:pilot_carbon_dioxide (P2 test record). No ideal_gas_cp: the package's reference spine icheme:spine_carbon_dioxide is the only ideal-gas source (D6). volume_translation: the Tr = 0.8 saturated liquid of the reference equation from the Java Helmholtz oracle (P1 rule b). Viscosity tables from CoolProp 8.0.0 (ae81610e). Written by tools/pilot-transport-tables/assemble_pilot_properties.py. normal_boiling_point_kelvin carries the normal sublimation temperature, 194.6855 K at 1 atm (Span and Wagner 1996): CO2 has no normal boiling point.

fluid_domain.evidence: Pilot package icheme:pilot_cryogenic (P3 design sections 1.3 and 8.1): from the CO2 triple point 216.592 K (Span and Wagner 1996) to 1200 K (steam-cracking coil outlet 1143 K target, 1200 K provisional) and 100 Pa to 10 MPa (hydrotreating ceiling). The declared critical band (plan section 3, widened in D7) is research-only inside this range; the range is qualified at G3 (WP9), not by this record. Viscosity above 2 MPa for dense states is a reference-pressure value (P3 design section 10). Below its triple point CO2 freezes under the package's crystal competition (P4, P5; D17 to D19: a gas, and a methane-rich liquid beside or towards its CO2-I crystal), qualified to 90 K; this record's data range is 216.592 K and up, and past it the fluid is carried with its properties continued (owner rule of 2026-10-16), a triple point being no lower bound.

volume_translation.reference: CoolProp dev/fluids/CarbonDioxide.json @ ae81610e7d23efc57f9d051c8e70a4d66e87537f (MIT; SHA-256 08e27e1a5a6029e508976496b9d1fd4f7f0caa2c46fd35c84b7bf520260a5217); Span and Wagner (1996), J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 25, 1509
volume_translation.oracle: science.thermo.reference.HelmholtzFluid (Java port of CoolProp's pure-fluid Helmholtz equations, test oracle of decision D4, commit 6ded7c7), saturation(T): equal pressure and Gibbs energy, vapour-side pressure
volume_translation.source: 0.8 x Tc of this record's PR78 constants; saturation pressure and saturated-liquid molar volume of the reference equation there, printed by tools/pilot-volume-anchors (anchors.json) and held to the oracle at 1e-12 by PilotVolumeAnchorTest; shift c = v_ref - v_PR,L(T, Psat_ref) = 1.169707 cm3/mol on the untranslated kernel (old 2 MPa anchor: 0.945916 cm3/mol)

freezing.source: The anchor of icheme:crystal_carbon_dioxide_i (revision crystal-carbon_dioxide-i-r2), its values and estimated flag. CO2 sublimes at 1 atm (194.7 K) and has no normal melting point: normal_melting_kelvin holds the triple point. The fusion enthalpy is the crystal's effective value for the pilot family. Data only: never a validity floor or a range end.

liquid.source: CoolProp 8.0.0 HEOS saturated-liquid viscosity (Q = 0), Laesecke and Muzny (2017), J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 46, 013107 via the CarbonDioxide.json transport block, from the triple point to the critical temperature; log-linear interpolation within 0.048 % of CoolProp everywhere but the last 0.0007 K below the critical point (1.12 % there). Saturation-pressure (reference-pressure) approximation: no pressure dependence. r2 (P5, batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature): below the triple point, to 90 K (a liquid carries CO2 there under the crystal competition, dissolved in liquid methane), the subcooled liquid: the same correlation evaluated by CoolProp 8.0.0 at the density of the Span-Wagner liquid branch at this table's reference pressure, 32 nodes within 0.047 % of it (tools/p5-solid-liquid-scans); the nodes from 216.592 K up are r1's unchanged. Below the triple point no measurement exists: both the equation of state's liquid and the correlation are extrapolated there.

vapor.source: CoolProp 8.0.0 HEOS zero-density viscosity (evaluated at 1e-6 mol/m3), Laesecke and Muzny (2017), J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 46, 013107, from the triple point to 1200 K; log-linear interpolation within 0.050 % of CoolProp. The pressure fields name the network's minimum pressure at which the table is read (reference-pressure approximation). r2 (P4 stage 2b, batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature): the same dilute-gas function from 90 K, the floor of the crystal competition's gas (CO2 carried by a gas beside or towards its CO2-I crystal), 19 nodes below the triple point within 0.043 % of CoolProp (tools/p4-network-rigs); the nodes from 216.592 K up are r1's unchanged. Below the triple point no measurement exists: the correlation's dilute-gas term, fitted to ab initio values, is extrapolated there.
